name: Cincinnati, OH
subtitle: Skyline chili, fine dining, and the Queen City table
items: Gold Star Chili (the rival — Skyline vs. Gold Star is a religion here)
Empress Chili (the original, since 1922 — the OG Cincinnati chili)
Montgomery Inn (The Boathouse, ribs since 1951 — Bob Hope's favorite)
Jeff Ruby's Precinct (converted police precinct, the KC-style steakhouse)
Orchids at Palm Court (Hilton Cincinnati, old-school grand hotel dining)
Boca (OTR, fine dining, David Falk — one of Ohio's best)
Senate (OTR, gastropub — hot dogs with foie gras, somehow it works)
The Precinct (same Jeff Ruby empire, separate steakhouse)
Graeter's Ice Cream (OTR original location — rank it AND eat it)
Zip's Café (Hyde Park, cash-only burgers since 1926)
